pr_title: Fix storyboard outro time potentially running too long
pr_body:
If a storyboard has a loop with a very high loop count (under the premise of it being ignored, ie. how stable handles this case), lazer would try to play out the full length of the loop.

This change brings handling in line with stable.

Can be tested with the tutorial ("new beginnings").

Closes #21008

issue_context.title: Storyboards with looping transforms can extend the outro time excessively
issue_context.body:
### Type

Game behaviour

### Bug description

if a song includes an ending section (i.e the video continues but there are no more notes) result screen wont appear when it should (once video ends). i think these sections try to extend a song length to around 7 minutes

this can be tested with the "new beginnings" beatmap included with lazer. in this map there are 4 minutes 50 seconds from the momend the last note is hit until result screen appears, when it should appear the exact moment it fades to black

### Screenshots or videos

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/34631489/198830738-d59f1204-8dc4-4e8a-a901-f90c3baf46d8.png)


### Version

comments:
This looks to happen when a storyboard loops an element for a long time past the end of the beatmap. This works on stable because loops are not normalised out, but on lazer the storyboard engine is unaware of when the beatmap ends and will realise all loops from the outset.

```
Sprite,Foreground,BottomCentre,"SB\hit.png",70,460
 L,17972,40
  R,0,0,2000,0,-0.03
  R,0,2000,6000,-0.03,0.03
  R,0,6000,10000,0.03,0
```

![JetBrains Rider 2023-01-11 at 08 50 13](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/191335/211760457-1b4398e5-67fe-4d12-bb3d-b4a6096420ce.png)
Bumping priority as this affects the tutorial, amongst other beatmaps.

If I'm reading stable source correctly, then loop commands (including anything nested within them) do not affect the map's end time at all (or at least not in ways you'd expect to), but other commands do. So if my understanding is correct, it seemingly _would_ be sufficient to just disregard `loops` here:

https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/9bcc6bf6dae08504f18755d50ec0240fff4563a9/osu.Game/Storyboards/StoryboardSprite.cs#L74-L85

It's a bit weird that stable doesn't count loops into end time though (and some of stable code surrounding that seems 100% bugged to me), so I'm not super sure I'd want to be PRing something like that raw without further comment, or a way to access the _correct_ end time...?
Nice find. Maybe it's enough to reproduce that behaviour until someone needs otherwise (with an inline comment yelling that it's not 100% correct).

i've tested against stable as well and would like to point out a minor detail as [discussed on the osb discord server](https://discord.com/channels/203050773645492224/483948766332846090/1072099377277054976):

for e.g. a 100,000 ms long map, 

```
 L,120000,10
  R,0,-120000,120000,0,1000
```

has the same effect as

```
 R,0,-120000,120000,0,1000
```

resulting in an intro at -120,000 ms and outro stretching to 120,000 ms. the first loop iteration's start and end times are taken as is (regardless of where the loop starts or how many iterations it has)

this also means that the solution in https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/11990 wasn't in line with stable, as sprite visibility does not matter for intros or outros on stable (although i agree with the direction taken in lazer).

I'm aware of what @Walavouchey points out above (and it's actually the "buggedness" of stable code I [alluded to](https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/21008#issuecomment-1418010390) above, as I found this yesterday when peering over at stable source). I just didn't want to go into detail describing it as it's just a 100% bug that isn't worth reproducing in lazer unless it causes actual issues with actual storyboards. So in the context of this particular issue I'll be looking away from that part of it.

right, and i'd argue that having similar logic as what's currently in [`StoryboardSprite.StartTime`](https://github.com/peppy/osu/blob/master/osu.Game/Storyboards/StoryboardSprite.cs#L29-L59) in [`StoryboardSprite.EndTime`](https://github.com/peppy/osu/blob/master/osu.Game/Storyboards/StoryboardSprite.cs#L74-L85) would be more correct than however stable handled it.

review_comments: As mentioned [in the issue thread](https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/21008#issuecomment-1418871537), there is a separate bug in stable's accounting of the intro/outro time with respect to loops, and if it was to be reproduced here, then this property would need to return just `CommandsDuration` instead. But because it's a nonsensical behaviour and thus clearly a bug, I am disregarding that unless it is proven that doing so breaks anything serious, and going forward with this right now because at least this value has a *semblance* of sanity.
